name: AVCon
blurb: Adelaide's volunteer-run anime, gaming and pop-culture festival at the Adelaide Showground, running since 2002.
notes: AVCon 2026 (Rhythm ☆ Revolution) ran July 4–5, 2026 at the Adelaide Showground — already over as of the 2026-10-05 checked date, so it falls outside the research window. No 2027 dates are announced yet: the homepage and /avcon-2026/guests/ page still show only the July 2026 event, schedule and guest lineup (confirmed guests for that past edition: Snuffy, Allegra Clark, SungWon Cho, ZalariaCos — not recorded here since that edition is outside the window). Will need re-checking once AVCon 2027 dates are announced.
